name: Total Bilirubin
description: Total serum bilirubin measuring both conjugated and unconjugated bilirubin fractions
reportDescription: Measures total circulating bilirubin in serum
interpretationGuidance: Elevated in hepatocellular damage, hemolytic disorders, or biliary obstruction.

name: Direct Bilirubin
description: Conjugated bilirubin fraction excreted by the liver into bile
interpretationGuidance: Elevated direct bilirubin suggests cholestasis, biliary obstruction, or hepatocellular injury.

name: Indirect Bilirubin
description: Unconjugated bilirubin calculated as Total Bilirubin minus Direct Bilirubin
interpretationGuidance: Elevated indirect bilirubin suggests hemolysis or impaired hepatic glucuronidation (e.g. Gilbert syndrome).

name: SGOT (AST)
description: Aspartate aminotransferase enzyme found in liver and heart tissue
interpretationGuidance: Elevated in hepatocellular necrosis, viral hepatitis, toxic liver injury, and myocardial infarction.

name: SGPT (ALT)
interpretationGuidance: Specific marker for hepatocellular injury and acute or chronic hepatitis.

name: Alkaline Phosphatase
description: Alkaline phosphatase enzyme associated with biliary tract and bone metabolism
interpretationGuidance: Elevated in biliary obstruction, cholestasis, infiltrative liver disease, and high bone turnover.

name: Total Protein
description: Total serum protein measuring the sum of albumin and circulating globulins
interpretationGuidance: Evaluates nutritional status, hepatic synthetic capacity, and protein-losing enteropathy or nephropathy.

name: Albumin
description: Serum albumin synthesized exclusively by the liver
interpretationGuidance: Decreased in chronic liver disease, malnutrition, nephrotic syndrome, and systemic inflammatory states.

name: Globulin
description: Serum globulin calculated as Total Protein minus Albumin
reportDescription: Calculated serum globulin fraction: TP - ALB
interpretationGuidance: Elevated in chronic infections, autoimmune diseases, and multiple myeloma; decreased in immunodeficiency.

name: A/G Ratio
description: Albumin to Globulin ratio calculated as Albumin divided by Globulin
interpretationGuidance: Decreased ratio seen in hypoalbuminemia (liver cirrhosis, nephrosis) or hypergammaglobulinemia.
